official_text: The quad twitches, but only while your thumbs are moving.
tts_text: The quad twitches, but only while your thumbs are moving.
phonemes: ðə kwˈɒd twˈɪtʃɪz, bˌʌt ˈəʊnli wˌaɪl jɔː θˈʌmz ɑː mˈuːvɪŋ.

official_text: With the sticks centred, it is calm.
tts_text: With the sticks centred, it is calm.
phonemes: wɪððə stˈɪks sˈɛntəd, ɪt ɪz kˈɑːm.

official_text: But slow, gentle turns carry a fine, nervous jitter, or quick stick stabs produce brief shakes that look far too sharp for the input.
tts_text: But slow, gentle turns carry a fine, nervous jitter, or quick stick stabs produce brief shakes that look far too sharp for the input.
phonemes: bˌʌt slˈəʊ, dʒˈɛntəl tˈɜːnz kˈaɹi ɐ fˈaɪn, nˈɜːvəs dʒˈɪtə, ɔː kwˈɪk stˈɪk stˈabz pɹədjˈuːs bɹˈiːf ʃˈeɪks ðat lˈʊk fˈɑː tˈuː ʃˈɑːp fəðɪ ˈɪnpʊt.

official_text: It is tempting to blame the gyro, or a vibrating mount.
tts_text: It is tempting to blame the gyro, or a vibrating mount.
phonemes: ɪt ɪz tˈɛmptɪŋ tə blˈeɪm ðə dʒˈaɪɹəʊ, ɔːɹ ɐ vaɪbɹˈeɪtɪŋ mˈaʊnt.

official_text: Feedforward responds to how fast the sticks are moving.
tts_text: feed-forward responds to how fast the sticks are moving.
phonemes: fˈiːdfˈɔːwəd ɹɪspˈɒndz tə hˌaʊ fˈast ðə stˈɪks ɑː mˈuːvɪŋ.

official_text: That makes the quad feel immediate.
tts_text: That makes the quad feel immediate.
phonemes: ðat mˌeɪks ðə kwˈɒd fˈiːl ɪmˈiːdɪət.

official_text: It also means that a stick signal arriving in uneven steps can become a push on the motors.
tts_text: It also means that a stick signal arriving in uneven steps can become a push on the motors.
phonemes: ɪt ˈɔːlsəʊ mˈiːnz ðˌatə stˈɪk sˈɪɡnəl ɐɹˈaɪvɪŋ ɪn ʌnˈiːvən stˈɛps kan bɪkˌʌm ɐ pˈʊʃ ɒnðə mˈəʊtəz.

official_text: Radio commands arrive in packets, and dropped or uneven packets create sudden drops and jumps in the feedforward trace.
tts_text: Radio commands arrive in packets, and dropped or uneven packets create sudden drops and jumps in the feed-forward trace.
phonemes: ɹˈeɪdɪˌəʊ kəmˈandz ɐɹˈaɪv ɪn pˈakɪts, and dɹˈɒpt ɔːɹ ʌnˈiːvən pˈakɪts kɹiːˈeɪt sˈʌdən dɹˈɒps and dʒˈʌmps ɪnðə fˈiːdfˈɔːwəd tɹˈeɪs.

official_text: Too much feedforward typically shows up as spikes in the motor traces with big stick steps, and as amplified shaking when the pilot is cold or nervous.
tts_text: Too much feed-forward typically shows up as spikes in the motor traces with big stick steps, and as amplified shaking when the pilot is cold or nervous.
phonemes: tˈuː mʌtʃ fˈiːdfˈɔːwəd tˈɪpɪkli ʃˈəʊz ˌʌp az spˈaɪks ɪnðə mˈəʊtə tɹˈeɪsɪz wɪð bˈɪɡ stˈɪk stˈɛps, and az ˈamplɪfˌaɪd ʃˈeɪkɪŋ wɛn ðə pˈaɪlət ɪz kˈəʊld ɔː nˈɜːvəs.

official_text: In the log, put the feedforward trace next to the stick input.
tts_text: In the log, put the feed-forward trace next to the stick input.
phonemes: ɪnðə lˈɒɡ, pˌʊt ðə fˈiːdfˈɔːwəd tɹˈeɪs nˈɛkst tə ðə stˈɪk ˈɪnpʊt.

official_text: Spikes that line up with stick movement, and carry into the motor outputs, point here.
tts_text: Spikes that line up with stick movement, and carry into the motor outputs, point here.
phonemes: spˈaɪks ðat lˈaɪn ˌʌp wɪð stˈɪk mˈuːvmənt, and kˈaɹi ˌɪntʊ ðə mˈəʊtəɹ ˈaʊtpˌʊts, pˈɔɪnt hˈiə.

official_text: There is a clean test: fly once with feedforward at zero.
tts_text: There is a clean test: fly once with feed-forward at zero.
phonemes: ðeəɹ ɪz ɐ klˈiːn tˈɛst: flˈaɪ wˈʌns wɪð fˈiːdfˈɔːwəd at zˈiəɹəʊ.

official_text: If nothing changes, feedforward is not the problem.
tts_text: If nothing changes, feed-forward is not the problem.
phonemes: ɪf nˈʌθɪŋ tʃˈeɪndʒɪz, fˈiːdfˈɔːwəd ɪz nˌɒt ðə pɹˈɒbləm.

official_text: A temporary wide deadband does the same for the radio link.
tts_text: A temporary wide deadband does the same for the radio link.
phonemes: ɐ tˈɛmpɹəɹi wˈaɪd dˈɛdband dˈʌz ðə sˈeɪm fəðə ɹˈeɪdɪˌəʊ lˈɪŋk.

official_text: If that changes nothing, the link is not the cause.
tts_text: If that changes nothing, the link is not the cause.
phonemes: ɪf ðat tʃˈeɪndʒɪz nˈʌθɪŋ, ðə lˈɪŋk ɪz nˌɒt ðə kˈɔːz.

official_text: Random wobbles in smooth cinematic footage usually come from a soft or flexy frame, slightly unbalanced props, or worn bearings.
tts_text: Random wobbles in smooth cinematic footage usually come from a soft or flexy frame, slightly unbalanced props, or worn bearings.
phonemes: ɹˈandəm wˈɒbəlz ɪn smˈuːð sˌɪnɪmˈatɪk fˈʊtɪdʒ jˈuːʒuːəli kˈʌm fɹɒm ɐ sˈɒft ɔː flˈɛksi fɹˈeɪm, slˈaɪtli ʌnbˈalənst pɹˈɒps, ɔː wˈɔːn bˈeəɹɪŋz.

official_text: If the twitch is there with the sticks centred, in calm air, and the feedforward test makes no difference, go back to the hardware.
tts_text: If the twitch is there with the sticks centred, in calm air, and the feed-forward test makes no difference, go back to the hardware.
